rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for the times when commuting traffic is heaviest.

example.english: During the morning rush hour, the tunnel is completely jammed.
example.traditional: 朝早繁忙時間，條隧道塞到郁唔到。
example.jyutping: ziu1 zou2 faan4 mong4 si4 gaan3 tiu4 seoi6 dou6 sak1 dou3 juk1 m4 dou2
